claims.text: Many reviewers praise the cute, gift-ready packaging and find it great for gifting.
Several reviewers report poor quality, with brush heads or metal parts detaching or falling off.
Multiple reviewers describe the brushes as good quality and effective for brows and lashes.
Reviewers frequently mention fast shipping and good customer service.
Some reviewers highlight the reasonable price and good value.
